body:
Q5: I AM RATIFYING §9.1 AND CLOSING MY DUPLICATE BEAD. movie-architecture had already done the
analytical half before I assigned it to anyone.

I took bd-01M184XP908JX51S3ZYFX20HC7 an hour ago after osf expired, then went to start it and found
plan §9.1 "Current Q5 disposition" already contains a real per-item table -- F0, Big Buck Bunny,
Sintel, FilmFestival, Sherlock, Brain Treebank, MF2 -- plus component-scoped provider dispositions
for Whisper/MFA, WhisperX, pyannote, learned checkpoints, ByteTrack and the Qwen/CLAP family. That is
better than the nine-model shortlist I wrote in the bead, which collab already told me was too
narrow. RATIFIED AS THE Q5 ANALYSIS. I am not producing a parallel table.

THE HONEST STATE, which §9.1 states plainly and which I want nobody to soften: NO EXACT SOURCE-FILM
PLUS HUMAN-RECALL PAIR IS PRESENTLY ADMITTED. Stage B cannot close while Sherlock is unresolved, and
the scientific film-recall vertical is blocked on an exact paired edition. The clean first
acquisition court is project-authored F0 media plus a 20-40 second checksummed Big Buck Bunny excerpt
through an LGPL-only FFmpeg build and weightless PySceneDetect -- proving ingest, timebase, gaps,
shot proposals and replay, and NOT ASR, identity, semantics or recall alignment. A first court that
declares what it does not prove is the right kind of first court.

WHAT REMAINS AND IS GENUINELY MINE: not the analysis -- THE OWNER-ACTION LIST. §9.1 and §9.2 scatter
five things that only the owner can do across two sections and a table, and an owner-action buried in
a disposition column is an owner-action that does not happen. Extracting them into one list is the
chief job here, and I am taking that as the remaining scope of the bead:

  1. pyannote.audio -- requires ACCEPTING GATED TERMS on Hugging Face. Owner only. Nobody clicks
     this on his behalf, and that has been the standing rule since the corpora.
  2. MF2 -- NC-SA, research-only. Owner decision required; excluded from defaults until then.
  3. Sherlock -- written ARTIFACT-LEVEL licence clarification. Held until obtained. Episode bytes
     are never vendored regardless of the answer.
  4. FilmFestival -- participant-content and REB basis for the viewed film editions.
  5. Any human recall corpus -- owner-recorded REB and redistribution basis before ANY recall bytes,
     prose, excerpts, provider logs or derived text enter git (§9.2).

Items 1 and 2 are quick decisions. Items 3, 4 and 5 involve other institutions and are the long
pole -- which means they should start now even though Stage B is gated behind other things anyway.
I am putting this list to the owner directly.

BEAD DISPOSITION: bd-01M184XP908JX51S3ZYFX20HC7 retitled to the owner-action list only, and it stays
mine. The component ledger closure that B0 still needs -- dependency, container, codec, tokenizer,
quantizer, privacy, retention, credential and service terms -- stays with movie-architecture under
plan b12f79c, where it already lives. Two beads, one boundary: they hold the ledger, I hold the
things only the owner can sign.
